scope: Only the four supplied 2026-27 prospectuses; original pages are counted from each PDF, not printed footers. Tamil Nadu citations use original page + mergedPageOffset. Kerala citations count the government-order cover.
publication: Draft, every sourced item remains unverified for human review.

uncertainties.title: Nationality text conflicts — original p7 / merged p7.
uncertainties.detail: The same eligibility clause says “Candidates should be a Citizen of India,” then says “Indian Nationals, Overseas Citizen of India (OCI), Persons with Indian Origin and Foreign Nationals are eligible” subject to State/institution rules, and later says OCI candidates are treated on par with Indian citizens and eligible for Open (General) seats. Affected item: gq-elig-nationality. The extraction preserves the clauses and asks candidates to confirm; it makes no automatic nationality exclusion or PIO/foreign-national entitlement.

uncertainties.title: Tamil Nadu nativity is not a profile fact — original p7–8 / merged p7–8.
uncertainties.detail: The text distinguishes candidates “claiming Nativity of Tamil Nadu” from candidates “native of other States,” but supplies no detailed nativity test in these pages. The profile’s domicile/school/birth facts are not treated as a proxy. Affected items: gq-elig-native-route, gq-elig-other-state-mbbs, gq-elig-nativity-and-dual, gq-doc-nativity, and gq-gap-nativity-definition. eligibility.manualReview blocks a definitive result until the Revenue certificate and route are checked.

uncertainties.title: NEET cutoff scopes overlap — original p8 / merged p8.
uncertainties.detail: The table prints “SC / ST / OBC (including person with disability)” at the 40th percentile/226 and “General Persons with Disability” at the 45th/244. The prose separately gives 40th percentile to Tamil Nadu natives in SC/SCA/ST/BC/BCM/MBC/DNC and 40th to SC-PH/ST-PH/OBC-PH. Affected item: gq-elig-neet-cutoff. Percentile/score and Tamil Nadu subcategory are not collected in the profile, so the rule is a manual warning, not an automated exclusion.

uncertainties.title: Current and completed PG exclusions exceed profile facts — original p9 / merged p9.
uncertainties.detail: The clauses say candidates “currently undergoing” PG Degree/DNB/equivalent/Diploma are not eligible and separately exclude candidates who “have already completed” PG Degree/DNB/equivalent, with a Diploma-holder exception. The profile’s currentlyInPG asks about admission on an earlier year’s NEET and does not record completed qualification/course level. Affected items: gq-elig-current-pg and gq-elig-prior-pg. Conditions remain null for manual review.

uncertainties.title: Service-tenure obligations do not align cleanly — original p10, p28–29 / merged p10, p28–29.
uncertainties.detail: Page 10 says service candidates “should have minimum of Five years left over service, at the end” of the PG course. Page 28 says service candidates with “more than five years of service after completing” the course execute a bond to superannuation, while page 28–29 says candidates with “less than 5 years of service after completing” must serve five years from the date they clear the exam, irrespective of superannuation, if required. Affected items: gq-elig-service-remaining, gq-service-long-service-bond, gq-service-short-service-bond. Both obligations are retained as written; no retirement-date rule is inferred.

uncertainties.title: PwD threshold and assistive-device exceptions conflict — original p25–26, p34–35 / merged p25–26, p34–35.
uncertainties.detail: Clause 35 says “more than 80% disabilities – NOT ELIGIBLE for admission,” while Annexure II says people with more than 80% locomotor disability “may also be allowed on case to case basis” if assistive devices bring it below 80% and functional competency is sufficient. Annexure II also marks visual/hearing disability at or above 40% as not eligible in the table, while footnotes say candidates above 40% may be considered if aids reduce the disability below 40%; the hearing footnote adds speech discrimination above 60%. Affected items: gq-elig-pwd, gq-elig-pwd-functional, gq-annexure-pwd, gq-doc-pwd-form-certificate. The exact matrix and clause are both retained; candidate outcome remains a manual medical-board/Committee decision.

uncertainties.title: PwD application form is referenced but not separately located — original p6, p34–36 / merged p6, p34–36.
uncertainties.detail: Page 6 requires a “filled and certified” special-category form said to be “provided in the prospectus.” Pages 1–60 include the disability matrix but no separately identifiable candidate application form. Affected items: gq-doc-pwd-form-certificate and gq-gap-pwd-form. The extraction retains the requirement and says to confirm where to obtain the form.

uncertainties.title: Round 3 eligibility wording differs — original p18–20 / merged p18–20.
uncertainties.detail: Page 19 clause 27(b)(i) says a candidate allotted from locked Rounds 1/2 choices “and has joined” may participate in Round 3; page 20’s detailed list includes candidates “allotted Joined / not joined” in Rounds 1/2 (State and All India), and the p18 table also lists some not-joined/resigned Round 2 candidates as eligible. Affected items: gq-round3-eligibility, gq-round3-fee-and-finality. The extraction follows the broader detailed eligibility list and retains the conflict for review; current DGHS/MCC notices may alter procedure.

uncertainties.title: Service candidate post-course requirement has a separate self-financing rule — original p28 / merged p28.
uncertainties.detail: Service candidates joining Government Quota seats in Self-Financing colleges are told to refer to “G.O. (Ms) No.46” dated 7th February 2020, but the order is not reproduced. Affected items: gq-service-private-college-order and gq-gap-sf-service-order. No terms from that order were imported.

uncertainties.title: Bond stamp-duty references conflict — original p30, p39 / merged p30, p39.
uncertainties.detail: Clause 37(i) cites “Indian Stamp Act of 1879 (Central Act II of 1879),” while the Annexure III form says “Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (Central Act II of 1899).” Affected items: gq-service-bond-stamp-duty and gq-annexure-bond. Both references are retained; the extraction does not decide which year is intended.

uncertainties.title: Ragging reference identifier differs from Annexure IV — original p31, p43 / merged p31, p43.
uncertainties.detail: Page 31 calls the reference an MCI “Letter No. MCI-34 (1) /2014 - Med (Ragg.) / 130894, dated 11.09.2014.” Annexure IV page 43 is headed “New Delhi, the 3rd August, 2009” and “No. MCI-34(1)/2009-Med./25453.” Affected items: gq-annexure-ragging, gq-admission-ragging. The extraction describes the reproduced 2009 notification and records the page 31 reference separately; it does not claim they are the same instrument. The reproduced excerpt ends after the hostel mentoring/visit directions on p46.

uncertainties.title: Tamil Nadu category distinctions are not modelled — original p7–8, p23–24, p47–60 / merged p7–8, p23–24, p47–60.
uncertainties.detail: The prospectus distinguishes BC, BCM, MBC, DNC, SC, SCA and ST and gives seat-count-dependent roster/fall-through rules. The profile has only broad OBC/SC/ST values, not the Tamil Nadu subcategories, the 200-point roster or specialty seat counts. Affected items: gq-elig-community-categories, gq-reservation-policy, gq-reservation-community-categories, gq-gap-community-category-model, and gq-gap-ews. eligibility.manualReview requires certificate and current-roster review. The exact community list, including district/region qualifications and omitted numbering, is retained under gq-annexure-communities.

uncertainties.title: Service definition cannot be reduced to employment alone — original p10–12 / merged p10–12.
uncertainties.detail: The source requires the specified TNPSC/MRB examination and appointment route or the Tamil Nadu local-body route, two years of continuous service by 31st March 2026, and certified service particulars. Affected items: gq-elig-service-candidate, gq-elig-service-not-eligible, gq-elig-service-remaining, gq-doc-service-order, and gq-doc-service-proforma. No employment-state or domicile proxy is used; the manual review rule remains active.

uncertainties.title: Round 2 fee is not stated clearly — original p4, p15–20 / merged p4, p15–20.
uncertainties.detail: Fees are stated for Round 1, Round 3 and Stray, but no separate Round 2 registration payment is described. Affected items: gq-fee-round1-registration, gq-fee-round3-registration, gq-fee-stray-registration, gq-fee-calculation-note, and gq-gap-round2-fee. The JSON lists only the fees named in the source and does not assume the Round 1 payment covers Round 2.

uncertainties.title: Security-deposit refund category remains undefined — original p5, p19 / merged p5, p19.
uncertainties.detail: The refund clause uses “eligible candidates” and requires no seat in any counselling phase; it separately excludes clause 27(b)(ii) Round 3 not-joined candidates. Affected items: gq-fee-deposit-refund and gq-gap-refund-eligibility. The extraction does not infer refunds in other resignation scenarios.

uncertainties.title: Course and college lists are missing — original p1, p22–23, p37 / merged p1, p22–23, p37.
uncertainties.detail: The cover scopes this document to MD/MS degree and Diploma; approved seats are to be displayed before counselling, but the PDF has no college/specialty seat matrix. Annexure III’s generic bond heading also names MDS, and prior-course exclusions mention DNB, but neither establishes GQ MDS/DNB seat coverage. Affected items: gq-gap-seat-matrix and gq-gap-course-scope. No MDS/DNB scope is inferred from those references.

uncertainties.title: Other schedule and ranking details are absent — original p2, p12–13, p23 / merged p2, p12–13, p23.
uncertainties.detail: The rank-list/counselling/course-start/closure dates are “Will be notified later.” No rank tie-break order, previous closing ranks, or current rural/difficult station list and partial-year weightage formula is given. Affected items: gq-gap-schedule, gq-gap-rank-tiebreak, and gq-gap-service-stations.

uncertainties.title: Metadata URL scheme is normalized.
uncertainties.detail: The cover prints the bare domain www.tnmedicalselection.net; the schema requires full URLs, so the JSON uses an HTTPS-prefixed URL. Confirm the final canonical scheme during parent integration.

uncertainties.title: Nationality conflict — original p5–6 / merged p65–66; IDs `mq-elig-nationality-wording`, `mq-gap-nationality-conflict`.
uncertainties.detail: Clause 5(i) says “Candidates should be a Citizen of India.” The next clause names “Indian Nationals, Overseas Citizen of India (OCI), Persons with Indian Origin and Foreign Nationals” as eligible subject to State and other rules. I kept this as a manual warning and did not automatically exclude OCI or foreign-national applicants. The NRI section separately requires a valid Indian passport or OCI card.

uncertainties.title: NRI candidate and sponsor tests — original p6–7 / merged p66–67; IDs `mq-elig-nri-applicant-groups`, `mq-elig-nri-passport`, `mq-elig-nri-financial-supporter`, `mq-elig-nri-blood-relative`, `mq-doc-nri-*`, `mq-gap-nri-manual`.
uncertainties.detail: The candidate routes include Indian-origin people settled abroad; people born abroad to Indian-origin parents; children of Indian citizens abroad for employment or business; children of PSU employees deputed abroad; and children of Central/State officials deputed abroad. The sponsor must be a parent, spouse, defined blood relative, or Court-declared guardian under the Guardians and Wards Act 1890. The defined relatives are the father's real brother/sister, mother's real brother/sister, paternal and maternal grandparents, and first-degree paternal or maternal cousins; the sponsor must be NRI. The source does not state a parent-absence exception. Existing `nriLink` facts cannot verify origin route, sponsor's NRI status, relationship degree, or Court order, so these stay manual.

uncertainties.title: NRI selection basis — original p6 / merged p66; IDs `mq-elig-nri-qualifying-marks`, `mq-gap-nri-selection`.
uncertainties.detail: The exact wording is admission “may be made” from marks in the qualifying examination “as prescribed.” The passage does not define which examination or criteria. The state rank-list rule separately says it is based on NEET PG 2026 marks (original p12 / merged p72); I preserved both statements and did not infer a different or exclusive NRI ranking method.

uncertainties.title: Qualifying thresholds and Tamil Nadu nativity — original p7–8 / merged p67–68; IDs `mq-elig-general-cutoff`, `mq-elig-reserved-cutoff`, `mq-elig-general-pwd-cutoff`.
uncertainties.detail: The visually checked table lists General 50th percentile / 262, SC/ST/OBC including PwD 40th / 226, and General-PwD 45th / 244. The following paragraph says 40th percentile for Tamil Nadu “natives” in SC, SC (Arunthathiyar), ST, BC, BC (Muslim), MBC and Denotified Communities, and 45th percentile for General PwD. The profile has no official Tamil Nadu native test, and its categories do not match BC/BCM/MBC/DNC/SCA exactly. I did not substitute domicile, birthplace, schooling or a nearby category as a proxy; the thresholds are manual checks.

uncertainties.title: Current / prior postgraduate qualifications — original p9 / merged p69; IDs `mq-elig-current-pg-course`, `mq-elig-completed-pg-course`, `mq-elig-diploma-holder`.
uncertainties.detail: The prospectus bars applicants currently undergoing any PG Degree, DNB, equivalent or Diploma; bars applicants who completed a PG Degree/DNB/equivalent; and bars a Diploma holder from another Diploma while allowing a PG Degree. The profile does not record all current or prior qualifications, so these rules remain manual rather than reusing a narrower `currentlyInPG` fact.

uncertainties.title: Round 3 / Stray eligibility and prior quota wording — original p17–20 / merged p77–80; IDs `mq-round3-eligibility`, `mq-round3-not-eligible`, `mq-round3-allotment-finality`, `mq-stray-eligibility`, `mq-gap-round-history`.
uncertainties.detail: Round eligibility depends on prior joining, resignation and current seats across State, All India, Deemed, DNB and Stray rounds. Several passages expressly say “State Quota” or “All India Quota” inside this Management/NRI prospectus. I kept the source wording and left round-history decisions manual; these items are tagged only for the Management/NRI seats represented by this prospectus and must not become global restrictions on other Tamil Nadu seat types.

uncertainties.title: Ambiguous “re-allotted and not joined” matrix row — original p17 / merged p77; ID `mq-round3-reallotted-not-joined`.
uncertainties.detail: The cross-round table has a separate “If Re-allotted and not joined” row saying the candidate “Cannot vacate the seat,” must pay a discontinuation fee, forfeits tuition and security deposit, and is not eligible for further rounds. The table placement does not clearly identify which re-allotment round this row addresses; I preserved it as a manual warning.

uncertainties.title: Discontinuation clause scope — original p13–17 / merged p73–77; IDs `mq-fee-discontinuation`, `mq-resign-after-round2`, `mq-resign-ladder-round2-late`.
uncertainties.detail: Clause 27(vi) says “State Quota candidates” when describing post-Round-2 discontinuation fees. The general discontinuation clause and counselling tables also give the ₹10 lakh Diploma / ₹15 lakh Degree penalties. The MQ/NRI extraction relies on the general clause and the tables, and does not import the separate State Quota-only sentence as an MQ rule.

uncertainties.title: Security deposit and NRI scope — original p4 / merged p64, cross-checked against original p21 / merged p81; IDs `mq-fee-security-deposit`, `mq-gap-deposit-nri-scope`.
uncertainties.detail: Clause 3 says “For Management Quota” the security deposit is ₹2,00,000. Because the prospectus title covers “Management Quota including NRI,” and Clause 32 places the NRI quota within Management Quota, the draft associates it with both views but records that scope for confirmation. Refund is within three months after counselling only if no seat is obtained in any phase; no interest is paid.

uncertainties.title: Minority documentation versus seat priority — original p11–13, p24, p26 / merged p71–73, p84, p86; IDs `mq-doc-minority-certificate`, `mq-doc-nativity`, `mq-annexure-ii`, `mq-reservation-minority-sharing`, `mq-gap-minority-allocation`.
uncertainties.detail: Annexure II is a religious and linguistic minority certificate from the candidate's native jurisdiction, at Tahsildar rank. It records religion and mother tongue and requires the candidate's Nativity certificate, parent's community certificate except for forward community, and parent's study certificate. The prospectus does not state the minority seat percentages, priority order or a profile-mappable minority test. These documents remain conditional manual checks.

uncertainties.title: Tuition, seat matrix, service bond — original p21–22 / merged p81–82; IDs `mq-gap-tuition-fees`, `mq-gap-seat-matrix`, `mq-gap-service-bond`.
uncertainties.detail: The prospectus delegates tuition and special-fee amounts to the Fee Fixation Committee, says approved college/course seats will be displayed before counselling, and provides no Management/NRI service-bond terms. No college or specialty list is supplied in this document.

uncertainties.title: Round 3 fee for joined candidates — original p18 / merged p78; IDs `mq-fee-round3-registration`, `mq-gap-round3-registration`.
uncertainties.detail: The clause says allotted candidates who did not join / resigned and fresh registrants pay ₹1,000, and says only candidates not allotted in Rounds 1 and 2 need not pay. It does not clearly state whether a candidate who joined and still holds a prior seat pays; this is flagged for confirmation.

uncertainties.title: Tamil Nadu nativity and MBBS route
uncertainties.detail: `dnb-elig-citizenship-mbbs-nativity`, `dnb-elig-dual-nativity`, `dnb-doc-nativity`; original pp.7–9, merged pp.98–100. Clause 5(b) says candidates must complete “MBBS course including the entire” CRMI/CRRI “in the State of Tamil Nadu”; Clause 5(c) addresses Tamil Nadu natives who “completed MBBS in other states”; Clause 10(b) excludes “candidates belonging to other states.” The prospectus does not state whether the nativity rule is an exception to the MBBS/internship rule. Kept all wording in a manual-check rule; no domicile proxy or resolution was applied.

uncertainties.title: NEET-PG cut-off score cells
uncertainties.detail: `dnb-elig-neet-percentiles`, `dnb-gap-dnb-qualifying-score`; original pp.7–8, merged pp.98–99. The p.98 table's minimum-eligibility and score-out-of-800 cells are blank. The p.99 prose gives the category percentile thresholds. Preserved the prose values and recorded the absent numeric score.

uncertainties.title: Service definition and five-year threshold
uncertainties.detail: `dnb-elig-service-routes-two-years`, `dnb-elig-temporary-service`, `dnb-elig-five-years-left`; original p.10 and p.27, merged pp.101 and 118. Clause 12 defines TNPSC/MRB examination routes and Tamil Nadu Local Body Medical Officers with two years' continuous service by 31st March 2026. The temporary-appointment clause cross-references only 12(a)(i), so it was not extended to 12(a)(ii). Clause 12 says “minimum Five years” left after training while Clause 26(d) says “more than 5 years”; exactly five years is unresolved and remains manual.

uncertainties.title: Service-bond compensation amounts
uncertainties.detail: `dnb-bond-state-compensation`, `dnb-bond-state-amount-sureties`; original pp.26–27, merged pp.117–118. Clause 26(b) states ₹40 lakh generally for service resignation/non-joining, while Clauses 26(c)–(d) give ₹40 lakh for DNB and ₹20 lakh for the two-year Diploma bond. Preserved both clause-specific statements; did not choose a Diploma amount for the general compensation sentence.

uncertainties.title: All India bond wording
uncertainties.detail: `dnb-bond-aiq-two-years`, `dnb-bond-aiq-amount-sureties`; original pp.27–28, merged pp.118–119. The prose says candidates are “mandatorily obligated” to serve for two years, while the bond clause says service is required “if the Government requires” it. The JSON keeps both phrases and states the condition in the bond record.

uncertainties.title: SCA conversion
uncertainties.detail: `dnb-res-sca-fill`, `dnb-reservation-conversion`; original p.23, merged p.114. Clause 30(g) says “SCA community shall be filled by candidates belonging to SC community ... vice versa,” then expressly says SC candidates may choose remaining SCA seats. Recorded the explicit SC-to-SCA opportunity; did not infer the reverse route.

uncertainties.title: PwD quota denominator and medical thresholds
uncertainties.detail: `dnb-res-pwd-five-percent`, `dnb-annexure-disability`, `dnb-doc-pwd`; original pp.24–25 and 38–40, merged pp.115–116 and 129–131. The 5% rule says “total number of seats available in Government Medical Institutions” without specifying whether it means both 50% halves or State Quota only. Clause 31 says >80% disability is ineligible, while the matrix describes case-by-case assistive-device review for some locomotor cases and the visual/hearing footnotes describe possible eligibility when aids reduce disability below 40%. Kept the full extracted matrix and flagged manual review.

uncertainties.title: Round 3 consequences
uncertainties.detail: `dnb-round3-nbe-join`, `dnb-round3-nonjoin-forfeiture`, `dnb-res-round3`; original pp.9 and 19–20, merged pp.100 and 110–111. Clause 8(b) adds a discontinuation fee and subsequent academic-year bar for a Round 3 allottee who does not join. Later Round 3 clauses/tables state forfeiture and no further counselling. Preserved each as a distinct consequence.

uncertainties.title: Annexure numbering
uncertainties.detail: `dnb-annexure-bond-form`, `dnb-annexure-disability`, `dnb-annexure-antiragging`, `dnb-admission-antiragging`; original pp.32–44, merged pp.123–135. Both the bond form and disability matrix are headed Annexure II. Clause 35(b) cites Annexure V for ragging, but the reproduced notification is headed Annexure IV. The candidate, parent/guardian and hostel undertakings are described; their blank forms are not included in the reproduced pages. The directions require an electronic affidavit/complaint database, behavioral certificates, a prevention/redressal plan, an anti-ragging committee contact, meetings with district administration/police, publicity, counselling, lighting/security, staff reporting undertakings, fresher reporting channels, mentoring and hostel checks. No separate squad is named in these pages.

uncertainties.title: DNB-specific profile facts
uncertainties.detail: `dnb-elig-manual-review` and `dnb-gap-profile-dnb-fact`. The existing profile has a general clinical course type but no DNB / MD-MS / Diploma subtype. DNB-specific restrictions have `condition:null` and manual-review notes; the manual-review block tells candidates to apply these rules only when seeking the DNB seats. No DNB rule is automatically applied to every clinical candidate.

uncertainties.title: Other profile gaps
uncertainties.detail: Tamil Nadu nativity/dual nativity, the full service appointment and retirement details, TN categories BCM/MBC/DNC/SCA, and disability type/percentage/aids are not collected by the current profile. These are recorded as manual checks or gaps. DNB fee totals are suppressed with `fees.calculationNote`; application and counselling fees remain separate options, and the ₹30,000 DNB deposit is distinct.

uncertainties.title: Missing items from source
uncertainties.detail: The rank/counselling/course-start schedule, DNB hospital/specialty seat matrix, tuition/special-fee and stipend amounts, numeric NEET cut-off score and any separate service-rank weightage/tie-break rule are not stated. These are in `gaps`.

uncertainties.title: NEET percentile cut-offs
uncertainties.detail: PDFs 6 and 8 set the 50th, 40th and 45th percentiles for General/EWS, listed SC/ST/SEBC and PwD combinations. Affected: elig-neet-pg, eligibility.manualReview. Handling: keep as a manual warning because the profile has no NEET score/percentile and its category field cannot distinguish Kerala's SEBC subgroups or OEC.

uncertainties.title: Kerala-origin route is not a domicile proxy
uncertainties.detail: PDF 7 says “Indian Citizens of Kerala Origin”; PDF 22 accepts the candidate's or either parent's Kerala birth proof. Affected: elig-kerala-origin, doc-nativity-proof, eligibility.manualReview. Handling: no isDomicile or bornInState shortcut. A parent-birth route and the meaning of Kerala origin are not collected by the profile; condition:null and manual documentation are used.

uncertainties.title: Non-Keralite MBBS and service routes
uncertainties.detail: PDF 7 allows a son/daughter of non-Keralite parents who graduated from a Kerala medical college, but excludes Communal/Special/PwD benefits and requires a one-year Senior Resident bond. The same page cites a 2024 Kerala High Court judgment allowing non-Keralite in-service doctors to apply under Service Quota. Affected: elig-nonkeralite-kerala-mbbs, elig-nonkeralite-service, doc-nativity-proof, serviceBond.bond, eligibility.manualReview. Handling: both routes remain manual because the profile does not collect parents' nativity or prove the judgment/service facts.

uncertainties.title: OCI and PIO language
uncertainties.detail: PDF 7 says OCI candidates are treated at par with Indian citizens and may use UR and NRI seats, then says “PIO/OCI candidates” cannot claim reservation. Affected: elig-oci, elig-nri-sponsor. Handling: encode OCI as UR (not a reserved category) and retain NRI sponsor requirements as manual. PIO has no profile value and receives no automatic route.

uncertainties.title: Age rules depend on a future notice date and service history
uncertainties.detail: PDF 7 gives 49 for MESQ and 47 for HSQ/IMSQ on 31 December of the year CEE issues its application notice, with at least 10 service years remaining after PG. Affected: elig-service-age, eligibility.manualReview. Handling: no age inference; condition:null. The actual notice year and remaining service cannot be calculated from the profile.

uncertainties.title: PwD application-stage conflict
uncertainties.detail: PDFs 10-11 say “No document/certificate is to be uploaded” with the online claim, but quote MCC guidance requiring a valid UDID card and Schedule 1 affidavit and later a certifying-authority 40% certificate. PDF 23 repeats the no-upload instruction. Affected: elig-pwd-assessment, reservation-pwd, doc-pwd-online-entry, doc-pwd-udid-affidavit, doc-pwd-medical-certificate. Handling: record online declaration separately from the cited UDID/affidavit/certificate requirements; mark the submission stage for manual confirmation.

uncertainties.title: PwD annexure scope and table thresholds
uncertainties.detail: PDFs 48-50 title Annexure V as guidelines for Medical-course admission and include MBBS-only notes, while PDFs 10-11 describe a PG State Level Committee and course-suitability process. Affected: elig-pwd-assessment, reservation-pwd, annex-v-pwd-guidelines. Handling: transcribe the listed disability categories, ranges, assistive-device and expert-panel criteria, and formula; warn that Annexure V alone does not settle every PG case. No specific disability/fitness result is automated.

uncertainties.title: Ex-Service seat count and dependents
uncertainties.detail: PDF 9 says “One ... seat each” for Ex-Service and dependent of a Jawan killed in action, with a fallback to a dependent of an Ex-serviceman; PDF 11 says one dependent seat prioritizes Jawan-killed-in-action dependents, then Ex-serviceman dependents; PDF 10 calls the special categories two seats outside the roster. Affected: elig-exservice, reservation-exservice, doc-exservice-discharge, doc-exservice-dependent-certificate. Handling: preserve the stated priority and certificate requirements, but flag the count/description conflict and require the published roster.

uncertainties.title: EWS limits and order citations
uncertainties.detail: PDF 11 cites G.O.(P) No.2/2020/P&ARD dated 03.01.2020; PDF 23 cites G.O.(Ms) No.23/2022/P&ARD dated 04.10.2022; PDF 80 cites G.O.(Ms) No.2/2020/P&ARD dated 12.02.2020. Annexure XVIII supplies no numeric family-income or asset limit. PDF 81 has a separate AAY/PHH ration-card form, requiring Kerala residence and the candidate's name on the relevant ration card; it excludes SC/ST/SEBC and its note also excludes OEC communities eligible for reservation from General Category. Affected: reservation-ews, doc-ews-certificate, annex-xviii-ews-formats, eligibility.manualReview. Handling: preserve both form routes, do not invent a threshold, and flag the conflicting order type/date.

uncertainties.title: SEBC list and Creamy Layer limits
uncertainties.detail: PDF 14 says eligible communities are in Annexure VIII “& VIII-A”; consolidated annexure list pages 43-44 lists Annexure VIII only, with the 2026 list on PDF 55 labelled as a continuation. The principal list's numbering skips 51, and spellings/aliases vary. PDF 56's NCL form refers to G.O.(P) No.1/2015/BCDD but does not give its numerical test. Affected: reservation-sebc-lists, reservation-sebc-shares, doc-sebc-oec-ncl, annex-viii-sebc-list, annex-ix-ncl-format. Handling: preserve both page-55 2026 continuation and printed names; do not invent Annexure VIII-A or a Creamy Layer income limit. Resolve eligibility against the official current list/certificate.

uncertainties.title: SC/ST list placeholders and glyph
uncertainties.detail: PDFs 51-53 print literal “xxx” entries. The SC entry for Mannan includes parenthetical glyphs rendered as £Ë¯Ï in extracted text and unreadable in the page image. Affected: annex-vi-sc-list, annex-vii-st-list. Handling: preserve printed xxx placeholders and explicitly mark the Mannan parenthetical as unreadable; do not fill the missing community names from outside material.

uncertainties.title: Service quota percentage statement
uncertainties.detail: PDF 15 says “10% of State Quota seats” are Service Quota and gives MESQ:HSQ:IMSQ = 45:45:10, then says “All State Quota seats other than those mentioned in Clause 6 (1 to 10)” are earmarked for Service Quota. Affected: reservation-policy, reservation-service-shares, elig-service-quota. Handling: record both statements and the ratio without reconciling them into a different percentage; seek CEE's operative matrix.

uncertainties.title: Service vacancy conversion, ranking and weightage
uncertainties.detail: PDFs 15-19 describe different department sponsors, the vacancy handoff (20% to IMS / 80% to DHS; if four or fewer seats, one to IMS), provisional/final departmental lists, complaints, PSC tie-break, rural weights and a service-use limit. PDF 16 references a 2013 Standardized Rural Institutions list that is not included; Annexure XI supplies a separate Difficult Rural list. Affected: elig-service-quota, elig-service-rank-weightage, elig-service-repeat, reservation-service-shares, annex-xi-difficult-rural-list. Handling: capture the stated weights, ranking process and service vacancy split; leave candidate-specific seniority and the referenced 2013 list manual.

uncertainties.title: IIMS Palakkad MESQ status
uncertainties.detail: PDFs 15 and 18 include lecturers of IIMS, Palakkad under MESQ but say inclusion is subject to the final Supreme Court judgment in pending SLPs. Affected: elig-service-quota, eligibility.manualReview. Handling: preserve the pending status; do not treat it as final.

uncertainties.title: NRI relationship wording
uncertainties.detail: PDF 23 repeats “Brothers and Sisters (inclusive of first cousins)” both before and after Husband/Wife in the sponsor list; PDFs 24-25 require a clearly explained relationship. The profile lacks sibling, cousin, spouse, half-sibling and adopted-parent categories as distinct facts. Affected: elig-nri-sponsor, doc-nri-sponsor-passport-status, doc-nri-employment-certificate, doc-nri-relationship-certificate, doc-nri-sponsor-affidavits, eligibility.manualReview. Handling: quote the source relationships in one manual rule, keep NRI-only seat tagging on NRI documents, and do not use nriLink as an exact proxy.

uncertainties.title: Dependent certificate recency
uncertainties.detail: PDF 11 says the Zilla Sainik Welfare Officer certificate must be obtained “not earlier than six months from the last date of submission of application.” The application closing date is not in this PDF. Affected: doc-exservice-dependent-certificate, gap-counselling-schedule. Handling: retain the relative six-month rule, do not convert it to an absolute date.

uncertainties.title: Security-deposit concession abbreviation
uncertainties.detail: PDF 31 says “SC/ST/OE and other candidates” pay ₹5,000 rather than ₹10,000; the abbreviation OE is not expanded in that sentence. Affected: deposit-fee-concession, fees-first-phase-deposit, fee-calculation-note. Handling: preserve OE in the item label/note and avoid making the profile calculate the concession.

uncertainties.title: Refund scope
uncertainties.detail: PDF 31 says the security deposit is returned to “eligible candidates” after the whole process, without a full eligibility definition; PDF 5 says fees may be refunded, forfeited or transferred depending on phase, exit and purpose. Affected: fees-first-phase-deposit, fees-refund-transfer, gap-counselling-schedule, resign-stage1, resign-stage2. Handling: state each printed amount and general outcome; do not invent missing early-round refund conditions.

uncertainties.title: Reservation conversion code
uncertainties.detail: PDF 34 uses “SM” without defining it; rows include minority, NRI and Service conversions and the prose adds SC/ST-to-OEC fallback. Affected: eligibility.quotaTerms, reservation.conversion, reservation-unavailed-scst. Handling: label SM as State Merit only because that phrase is used nearby, mark it undefined, and include the prose fallback in a separate step.

uncertainties.title: T.C. Medical Council duplicate
uncertainties.detail: PDF 33 first requests a “Permanent Registration Certificate from Kerala State Medical Council / erstwhile T.C. Medical Council,” then separately lists “T.C Medical Council.” Affected: doc-kerala-registration, doc-admission-originals. Handling: include one registration document and flag the separately printed bullet as unclear rather than infer a second certificate type.

uncertainties.title: Bond count and form assignment
uncertainties.detail: PDF 35 says “execute two bonds”; PDF 38 says there are “two separate Bonds—one for the Service Candidates and another for non-service Quota candidates including AIQ.” Annexures XIV-XVI have different text and scopes. Affected: bond-general-service, bond-prospectus-form-conflicts, doc-bond-forms, admit-bond-time-and-damages. Handling: do not assert which combination a candidate signs; tell them to use the form issued by the admitting institution.

uncertainties.title: General bond scope across college sectors
uncertainties.detail: PDF 4 says only admission-related procedures apply to self-financing admissions, while clause 11 on PDF 35 says General Merit candidates admitted to Medical PG courses in Kerala owe service. Affected: bond-general-service, admit-bonded-service. Handling: quote the stated duty and mark private-sector applicability unresolved.

uncertainties.title: Service-bond durations and damages
uncertainties.detail: PDFs 37-38 state a 10-year service obligation (two years difficult/remote/rural) and a future-salary damages formula, while Annexure XIII (2017 order) gives other prospective periods and Annexures XV-XVI have crossed-out period fields, 2025 references and a fixed ₹50,00,000 line. Affected: serviceBond.bond, bond-service-quota-duty, bond-service-damages, bond-prospectus-form-conflicts, annex-xiii-health-deputation, annex-xv-service-bond-form, annex-xvi-deputation-bond-form. Handling: preserve the main 2026 obligation, formula and printed form terms separately; no service-candidate total is calculated.

uncertainties.title: Annexure index irregularities
uncertainties.detail: PDFs 43-44 number rows inconsistently, list Annexure IV(a) with historical 2024-25/2025-26 labels, omit Annexure XVII and list Annexure XVIII next. PDF 47 repeats prior-year headings for seat distribution and says “Will be notified separately.” Affected: annex-iii-seat-distribution, annex-iv-category-distribution, gap-2026-seat-matrices. Handling: record only annexures present; do not synthesize missing Annexure XVII or current seat rows.

uncertainties.title: Annexure XI scan readability
uncertainties.detail: PDFs 60-62 are low-resolution scans. The names transcribed from the images include uncertain spellings at Thrissur PHC “Thonoor...kara” (PDF 60), Kozhikode PHC “Kunduthode” (PDF 61), Wayanad “R.M.C.H. Chern...” (PDF 61), and Kasaragode PHC “Medinjar” (PDF 62). Affected: annex-xi-difficult-rural-list, elig-service-rank-weightage. Handling: retain each entry with an explicit uncertainty marker in the description; require higher-quality source confirmation before publication. Remaining station names were read from the scanned page images and checked against OCR as a reading aid only.

uncertainties.title: Annexure IX NCL threshold
uncertainties.detail: PDF 56 certifies not-Creamy-Layer status under a Government Order/schedule but does not reproduce the income test. Affected: annex-ix-ncl-format, doc-sebc-oec-ncl, reservation-sebc-lists. Handling: require the prescribed Village Officer certificate; do not invent an income or asset threshold.

uncertainties.title: Annexure XIV-XVI form wording
uncertainties.detail: PDF 71-73 says the generic form includes ₹50,00,000 and course costs; PDF 74-76 mentions the 2025-26/2025 prospectus and all-candidate ₹50,00,000; PDF 77-79 refers to the 2017 Finance Order and again cites the 2025 prospectus. Affected: bond-general-service, bond-service-damages, bond-prospectus-form-conflicts, annex-xiv-general-bond-form, annex-xv-service-bond-form, annex-xvi-deputation-bond-form. Handling: preserve the printed amounts and clauses while flagging route-specific applicability.

uncertainties.title: Exactly five remaining service years is not assigned to a bond group
uncertainties.detail: Original/merged pp.10,28–29 require at least five years for eligibility but describe bonds for more than five and less than five. Confirm the exactly-five-year case.

uncertainties.title: Parent-community certificate trigger differs
uncertainties.detail: Original/merged p7 asks all community-reservation claimants for a parent certificate; p12 phrases this for candidates claiming both nativity and community reservation. Confirm the applicable requirement.

uncertainties.title: Annexure III declaration scope
uncertainties.detail: Original p11/merged p71 lists the declaration for NRI candidates without a ward-only exception; the original p27/merged p87 form is headed for children of NRIs or their wards. Confirm how the form applies to the candidate route.

uncertainties.title: Stray eligibility for timely resigned candidates
uncertainties.detail: Original p19/merged p79 mentions not-joined/resigned candidates in its fee clause, while its eligibility list does not explicitly name timely resignations. Confirm with the Selection Committee.

uncertainties.title: Stray eligibility for resigned candidates
uncertainties.detail: Original p21/merged p112 names resigned candidates in the registration-fee paragraph but not expressly in the eligibility list. Confirm whether a timely resigned candidate may participate.

uncertainties.title: Round 3 registration for holders of an earlier joined seat
uncertainties.detail: Original p20/merged p111 states pay/no-pay cases but does not settle the charge for a joined Round 1/2 candidate seeking upgradation.

uncertainties.title: Round 3 non-joining fee cross-reference
uncertainties.detail: Original p9/merged p100 refers to Clause 23(c) for a non-joiner, while original p15/merged p106 describes candidates who joined and then discontinued. The non-joining matrix gives separate forfeitures. Confirm the operative fee.

uncertainties.title: DNB deposit quota scope
uncertainties.detail: Original p4/merged p95 states ₹30,000 for Government Institutions/Hospitals without expressly saying State Quota-only or AIQ. Confirm the quota applicability.

uncertainties.title: Stamp Act year differs
uncertainties.detail: Original p28/merged p119 cites 1879; original p33/merged p124 bond form cites 1899. Confirm the issued form and correct legal reference.

uncertainties.title: Service-seat transfer clauses differ
uncertainties.detail: PDF p. 19 prohibits transfers under any circumstances after occupying a service seat/finalizing options, then mentions transfers only through scheduled CEE allotment before closure. Confirm the permitted situation.

uncertainties.title: Regular-rural institution list is missing
uncertainties.detail: PDF p. 16 references the Standardized list of Government Allopathic Medical Institutions-2013, which is not included. Annexure XI is a separate Difficult Rural list; institution and service dates require departmental confirmation.

uncertainties.title: Minority seat criteria are not supplied
uncertainties.detail: PDF p. p26,34 mention Muslim Minority and All Christian Minority quotas but do not supply full eligibility, proof or priority rules.

uncertainties.title: 2017 order number differs from deputation bond
uncertainties.detail: PDF p. 66 order heading prints 106/2017/Fin; PDF p. 77 form prints 016/2017/Fin. Confirm the correct reference and institution-issued form.

uncertainties.title: CEE portal punctuation differs
uncertainties.detail: PDF p. 26 uses www.cee-kerala.gov.in; several other passages use www.cee.kerala.gov.in. The guide uses the repeatedly printed dot-domain; confirm from the operative CEE notice.

uncertainties.title: Service-quota heading and broad admission exclusion
uncertainties.detail: Original/merged p.10 is headed non-eligibility for Service Quota but says specified temporary appointees with under two years of service are not eligible for PG admission generally, even if inadvertently certified. Confirm the operative route scope.

uncertainties.title: Roster court reference is garbled
uncertainties.detail: Original/merged p.23 conditions the roster on a final court verdict but prints “Supreme Madras” amid mixed court/case wording. Confirm the operative court and roster position.

uncertainties.title: Stray eligibility for timely resigned candidates
uncertainties.detail: Original/merged pp.20–21 names resigned candidates in the fee paragraph but not expressly in the eligibility list. Confirm whether the candidate may participate.

uncertainties.title: Sponsor passport versus OCI card wording
uncertainties.detail: Original p.6/merged p.66 accepts a supporter’s Indian passport or OCI card; original p.11/merged p.71 and the checklist repeat only a valid Indian passport. Confirm OCI supporter proof.

uncertainties.title: Processing fee versus registration fee name
uncertainties.detail: Original p.9/merged p.69 calls a forfeited charge processing fee, while later tables/clauses call it registration fee. Confirm whether these are the same charge.

uncertainties.title: 2014 letter versus 2009 anti-ragging notification
uncertainties.detail: Original p.23/merged p.83 references a direction dated 11th September 2014; Annexure IV on original p.28/merged p.88 is headed 3rd August 2009. Confirm the operative reference.

uncertainties.title: OEC fee-concession certificate alternative and reservation proof
uncertainties.detail: PDF pp.5–6 allows Community Certificate or NCL for OEC fee concession, while a Community Certificate alone does not obtain reservation; PDF p.22 asks SEBC/OEC candidates for NCL. Confirm the certificate for the exact claim.

uncertainties.title: RCC final-round registration amount
uncertainties.detail: PDF p.32 makes the fee equal the tuition of the seat opted; PDF p.5 prints ₹57,890 only for Government Medical Colleges and delegates RCC fees. The Government figure/half-rate cannot establish RCC’s amount.

uncertainties.title: 2022 NBE reference in current Round 3 clause
uncertainties.detail: Original p.9/merged p.100 refers to NBE norms “for 2022” for the subsequent-year bar within this 2026-2027 prospectus. Confirm the operative current rule.

uncertainties.title: Government Quota self-financing non-service bond terms
uncertainties.detail: The non-service bond clauses on original/merged pp.29–30 expressly concern Government Medical Colleges. The corresponding Government Quota self-financing-college terms are not established here; confirm the issued obligation.

uncertainties.title: AIQ unpaid-penalty certificate-retention scope
uncertainties.detail: Original/merged p.15 states AIQ discontinuation fee/tuition forfeiture, then places the non-relief/certificate-retention sentence after the separate State Quota clause. Confirm the retention scope for AIQ.

uncertainties.title: Parent community-certificate original at joining
uncertainties.detail: Original/merged p.12 requires parent-community-certificate upload in specified cases; p.14 joining originals list does not expressly repeat the parent certificate. Confirm whether its original is required at joining.

uncertainties.title: On-time Round 2 registration-fee forfeiture
uncertainties.detail: Original/merged p.18 table gives registration-fee forfeiture for allotted/re-allotted non-joined/resigned candidates, while pp.16–17 separately allow on-time resignation and describe non-join forfeiture. Confirm the treatment for an on-time resignation.

uncertainties.document: Tamil Nadu Government and Management/NRI MD/MS/Diploma
uncertainties.title: Earlier joined-course discontinuation trigger date is not printed
uncertainties.detail: Government-quota original/merged pp.9,15 and Management/NRI original p.9/merged p.69 refer to a Selection Committee specified date for an earlier joined-course discontinuation fee. That operative date and notification are not supplied in these files. Confirm the applicable notice and case scope.
